name: tiny11builder
description: WinUI app for building smaller, customized Windows 11 images.
one_liner: A free app that strips the bloat out of Windows 11 so it runs well on old or cheap computers.
buyer: A small IT shop or refurbisher that sells or re-images older PCs and wants a lean, fast Windows install without manually stripping it by hand each time.
business_use_cases: A computer refurbishing business images every used laptop it sells with a stripped-down build so older hardware feels fast, as a selling point over stock Windows.
A school or nonprofit IT department builds lean images to keep aging lab computers usable for a few more years instead of replacing them.
A kiosk or digital-signage integrator uses a minimal Custom build to deploy locked-down Windows machines for which bundled apps and services are pure risk and overhead.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'lean Windows re-imaging' service for refurbishers and small businesses, charging per device or per fleet.
Sell pre-built, use-case-specific image profiles (kiosk, school lab, low-RAM laptop) as paid templates on top of the free tool.

steal_this: Offer local used-PC resellers a flat-fee 'optimized Windows image' add-on for every machine they sell, using this tool to do the stripping.
